# VRFLogStore

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Logging` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Logger/VRFLogStore.cs#L15)

Collects every framework log line whether or not the window is open, so opening the Logger
shows what already happened instead of starting blank.
Kept as a ScriptableSingleton backed by a file in Library: Unity re-serializes it around a
domain reload, which is what lets the buffer survive entering play mode and recompiling.

```csharp
[FilePath("Library/VRFrameworkLogger.dat", FilePathAttribute.Location.ProjectFolder)]
public class VRFLogStore : ScriptableSingleton<VRFLogStore>
```
